ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the alleged Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and follow the money trail to uncover the extent of the fraud and those involved.
questions: What is the extent of the Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Who is involved in the fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and corruption, and I recommend pursuing it further. The investigation should follow the money trail and interview key witnesses and experts to gather evidence.
